title: DEBUG window only receives focus when mouse cursor enters the game viewport.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Focusing back into the DEBUG window that opens when running a Scene doesn't work until you move the cursor into the game viewport.

I'd expect the game to receive focus – and thus input – when I put the window into focus, without requiring the mouse to enter the viewport itself.

Seems like trying to focus onto the DEBUG window gives focus to the "main" part of the application – the editor – instead, until the viewport is "activated" by entering it with the mouse. 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Setup scene to make NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_IN and NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_OUT visible.
2. Run a Scene.
3. Resize the resulting DEBUG window to show the dark border around the central viewport with the game itself.
4. Put focus away from that window.
5. Put focus back into the window by clicking on the dark border (NOT the viewport itself).
6. Game doesn't receive input (other than mouse movement) and instead the editor itself receives it.
